ADDED i2: Serializing a doctype that carries an internal subset to a generic appendable does not change the node name, which is always "#doctype".
ADDED i3: An empty doctype (no name, public id or system id) serializes to the lowercase HTML5 form "<!doctype>".
ADDED i4: A doctype that has a name, public id and system id serializes to the uppercase PUBLIC form including both quoted identifiers.
ADDED i5: With XML output syntax an empty doctype keeps the uppercase "<!DOCTYPE>" form (the lowercase aesthetic only applies to HTML syntax).
ADDED i6: Overriding the PUBLIC/SYSTEM key with a non-null value leaves the node name unchanged.
ADDED i7: Passing null to setPubSysKey is a no-op and leaves the node name unchanged.
ADDED i8: systemId() returns the system id supplied to the constructor.
ADDED i9: publicId() returns the (empty) public id supplied to the constructor.
ADDED i10: name() returns the name supplied to the constructor.
